messages:
Nadia: ok folks that was a wild all-hands, my cheeks hurt from laughing :joy:
Ethan: which part made you laugh the most? Miguel's benchmark slide or the demo soundtrack?
Ravi: the unexpected cat cameo in the demo recording stole it for me :cat2:
Lina: i vote "Cat 2: The Return" as the next internal codename 
Maya: completely agree. new sprint name: cat-2-return :cat:
ops-bot: Quick poll started by Nadia: Should we turn the demo cat into a sticker? Vote here: /poll yes no maybe
Nadia: also — who brought the giant rubber duck? it was front row and proud :duck:
Ethan: that was me. its my stress-relief mascot. happy to loan it out :grin:
Ravi: shoutout to people who logged in from weird timezones. hero energy :earth_asia:
Lina: can we GIF-ify the mic-drop moment and add to the 'Hall of Fame' board?
Maya: yes pls. ill capture a clip. also taking nominations for best one-liner
Nadia: favorite one-liner: "we measure latency in micro-excited states" :nerd_face:
Ethan: best reaction award goes to Lina for the slow clap that turned into a standing ovation :clap: (reaction :trophy:)
ops-bot: Recording & slides uploaded: https://storage.redwood/ah/1768034567/recording.mp4 | https://storage.redwood/ah/1768034567/slides.pdf
Ravi: can someone pin the tacos photo from the kitchen? it looked like a national monument.
Lina: pinned. also tagging facilities to confirm next week's snack schedule. @facilities
Maya: tiny ask: can we schedule a 15min "after party" hangout tomorrow for meme swaps? low pressure, bring your own tea :tea:
Nadia: yes im bringing memes and bad puns. see you there :sparkles:
Ethan: goodnight all-hands survivors. you did great :)
